app_summary: An online shop selling astronomy products, based on the OpenTelemetry Demo. It is built with polyglot microservices (Go, Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Rust, ...) communicating via gRPC and HTTP behind an Envoy frontend-proxy, with Kafka for asynchronous order processing and Valkey as cart store. Supported Operations: View product catalog, Receive product recommendations and ads, Add item to cart, Checkout with selected items, Currency conversion, Process payment, Generate shipping quotes, Send order confirmation emails

rca_analyses_list.diagnosis: OpenTelemetry Collector (otel-collector-agent-66zb4) kubelet_stats receiver failing TLS verification when scraping the kubelet /stats/summary endpoint. Logs show: "Get \"https://172.18.0.6:10250/stats/summary\": tls: failed to verify certificate: x509: cannot validate certificate for 172.18.0.6 because it doesn't contain any IP SANs". This causes node/kubelet metrics not to be scraped by the collector (observability failure).

args.evidence_summary:
1) kubectl get pods (astronomy-shop): all application pods (frontend, frontend-proxy, checkout, payment, etc.) are Running.
2) frontend logs (frontend-559ccb996b-hwtj9): many successful API responses (HTTP 200) and "Order placed successfully" messages — application request flow (catalog, cart, checkout) is functioning.
3) frontend-proxy logs (frontend-proxy-55b6b6c7d9-wbqkl): Envoy started with warnings but no runtime errors affecting traffic.
4) otel collector logs (otel-collector-agent-66zb4): repeated errors scraping kubelet metrics: "tls: failed to verify certificate: x509: cannot validate certificate for 172.18.0.6 because it doesn't contain any IP SANs".
args.investigation_summary: I checked trace availability for the entry-point (frontend-proxy) and several backend services (no error traces present). I listed pods to verify application health. I inspected logs for frontend-proxy and frontend to confirm request flow and orders; both show successful handling of requests and order placement. Finally I checked the OpenTelemetry collector logs and found repeated TLS verification errors when contacting the kubelet /stats/summary endpoint, indicating an observability/metrics scraping failure rather than a functional outage.

evaluation.rca_motivation: Ground truth is a traffic surge overloading the frontend, increasing its latency and resource usage. The agent instead describes an otel collector TLS misconfiguration causing missing kubelet metrics (observability issue). This is a different component and unrelated root cause, so it is completely off-target.
